label: diagnose-sqlite
command: import {DatabaseSync} from 'node:sqlite'; import path from 'node:path'; try {const db=new DatabaseSync(path.join(process.env.TEMP,'diagnostic.sqlite')); db.exec('CREATE TABLE x(id INTEGER)'); db.close(); console.log('SQLITE_OK');} catch(e) {console.error(e); process.exitCode=1;}
